meta.note: Mission counts: walkthroughs report 91–96 main missions depending on how short story steps are counted (readdork: 91 + 28 steps + 23 optional; leonidatricks: 96 + 23 + 24). Chapter 1 counts differ because some sites fold the prologue in.

chapters.name: Just Like Paradise
chapters.note: Includes the prologue era and Jason's Keys errands for Brian Heder.

chapters.name: Paradise Lost
chapters.note: Counts differ across walkthroughs because of how Chapter 2's short steps are split.

chapters.name: Tits Ass Drug Money
chapters.note: Includes meeting Mia Caminos (Mami Knows Best) and the Vice City move.

chapters.name: Vice City, Baby
chapters.note: Deep in Vice City: Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan, Real Dimez, Raul Bautista jobs.

chapters.name: Top of the World, Ma
chapters.note: Endgame — includes the Niko Bellic cameo and the finale.

missions.name: Lucia's Release
missions.summary: The prologue: Lucia is prepared for release from the Leonida Penitentiary. The game's menu explicitly frames this as taking place before she leaves prison.

missions.name: Gone Fishing
missions.summary: Early Jason mission in the Keys (per PowerPyx's published mission list).

missions.name: Pipework
missions.summary: Brian asks Jason to collect overdue rent from Mandy. She refuses to pay until Jason fixes her blocked sink — and spends the visit flirting with him. Viral details: a severed finger in the sink, tubs of acid and a possible fresh grave in the garden.

missions.name: Hey Arnold!
missions.summary: Meet Brian (per PowerPyx's published mission list).

missions.name: Feng Shui
missions.summary: Meet Cal (per PowerPyx's published mission list).

missions.name: Buck Me
missions.summary: Set up the BuckMe bank account — the game's money-deposit system (short story steps around it include depositing cash).

missions.name: Coming Home
missions.summary: Lucia's Release story step — Lucia leaves prison.

missions.name: Mami Knows Best
missions.summary: Lucia catches up with her mother Mia at Peacock Bay, Vice City; Mia takes her to see the first property she has to sell — a run-down house in Hamlet.

missions.name: Dealer's Choice
missions.summary: Go see Dre'Quan (per PowerPyx's published mission list).

missions.name: Car Service
missions.summary: Steal the car for Raul Bautista.

missions.name: Taking Liberties
missions.summary: Jason, Lucia and Giorgio Gallo meet an older Niko Bellic over a $2 billion cartel shipment. Niko explains the shipment went wrong, says he hasn't killed anybody since 2012, knocks Gallo down, points a gun at him, looks at Jason, and leaves.

missions.name: Protective Custody
missions.summary: Late Chapter 5 mission preceding the finale; one guide reports an earlier prompt in this mission can affect the ending pool (guides disagree — marked UNCONFIRMED for that detail).

missions.name: The End of the Road
missions.summary: The 91st and final mission. Starts at Cal's place in the Keys: gear up, assault a waterfront tower for a hard drive, escape through a construction site, drive south. A tip-off changes the plan and ends at a bridge blocked by sheriff's cars, helicopter overhead. ~25 minutes in, after a car conversation, the game freezes with two prompts: Swim for It (Triangle/Y) and No Surrender (R2/RT).

choices.outcome: Can end in multiple ways; guides disagree on what decides the variant. Confirmed by footage: multiple outcomes exist.
Ends with both protagonists dead (confirmed by multiple complete finale runs).

missions.rewards: Gold trophy: "You Gotta Know When to Get Off". After the credits you return to free roam before the finale.

length.claim: 65+ hours main campaign; 90–100 with side content; 200+ for 100%
Median finish time 56h 50m among 344 tracked players (as of Nov 25, 2026)
No mission replay and no gold medals in the story
